content:
I don’t have access to your mic or speakers directly—I only work through text in this interface.

However, depending on what app or platform you’re using, you may be able to:

- **Use your voice to talk to me**:  
  Some interfaces let you press a microphone button, speak, and they transcribe your speech to text for me.

- **Have my replies read aloud**:  
  Many apps or browsers have text‑to‑speech, or a “listen”/speaker icon, that will read my responses out loud.

If you tell me which app/site you’re using (e.g., mobile app, web browser, which service), I can give step‑by‑step instructions for enabling voice input or text‑to‑speech there.
